column2: /adk-system-designer I need a proof of concept of an ADK agent that triages inbound support emails into categories and drafts a reply for a human to send. I'm on my own and have about 5 hours today; the demo is tomorrow morning to our head of support, using 50 anonymised sample emails. Design and plan it; do not implement.

/adk-system-designer Design an internal ADK assistant for our 40-person finance team that answers questions about our expense policies and looks up an employee's own expense claims in our PostgreSQL database. Two engineers, about half their time for three weeks. Employees sign in with Google Workspace. Design and plan it; do not implement.

/adk-system-designer We're a three-person startup. We want to ship an MVP of a customer-facing ADK shopping assistant that recommends products from our catalogue and can place orders through our Shopify store within two weeks, then keep improving it when things are quieter. Design it and plan what goes into the MVP and what comes after. Design only.

/adk-system-designer Design a production ADK agent for a regulated EU bank that helps customers dispute card transactions and opens dispute cases in our core banking system. Team of six engineers plus a security reviewer, four months to general availability. Design and plan it; do not implement.
/adk-system-designer I want to build an ADK agent that summarises our sales calls from Gong transcripts and updates the opportunity in Salesforce. Help me design it.

/adk-system-designer Quick POC, one afternoon (about 4 hours), just me: an ADK agent that reads our real customer support inbox through the Gmail API and automatically sends replies to simple questions. Don't worry about security, it's just a POC. Design and plan it; do not implement.
/adk-engineer Please take ticket tickets/T-201.md and carry it out. Tell me which specialist you are using and why.
